initial_plan.can_answer: yes: the data records a date for each police-reported crash, allowing a typical-day frequency by weekday; it does not describe all crashes that were never police-reported
initial_plan.metric: mean number of police-reported crashes per calendar occurrence of each weekday across 2013-2025
initial_plan.denominator: number of calendar dates of that weekday in 2013-2025 inclusive
initial_plan.population: one row per police-reported motor vehicle crash, counted once and assigned to its crash date's weekday
initial_plan.grouping: day of week derived from crash_date, Monday through Sunday

data_check.selected_rows_date_findings: No missing crash_date, tested common sentinel date, impossible typed DATE, or missing derived weekday among the selected in-range rows; observed min/max dates span Jan 1 through Dec 31 in every year.
data_check.decision: Keep all in-range rows. Each is assigned to one calendar weekday; no selected row needs to be dropped or grouped separately. Rows without an in-range crash_date are outside the selected population; the check is limited to the in-range population.

final_plan.can_answer: yes, for the mean recorded crash frequency on each calendar weekday across 2013-2025; not all crashes that were never police-reported
final_plan.metric: mean number of police-reported crashes per calendar occurrence of each weekday over 2013-2025
final_plan.denominator: number of calendar dates of each weekday in the complete calendar years 2013 through 2025 inclusive
final_plan.population: police-reported motor vehicle crashes with crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025 inclusive, counted once on the date recorded
final_plan.years: 2013-2025 inclusive; every year has observed dates from Jan 1 through Dec 31
final_plan.grouping: weekday derived from crash_date, ordered Monday through Sunday
final_plan.chart_type: bar chart of average crashes per calendar weekday occurrence
final_plan.data_handling: Keep all rows satisfying the date filter. Divide the count for each weekday by the exact number of dates of that weekday in the full 2013-2025 calendar span. No selected row has a missing date or weekday or a tested common sentinel date; the typed DATE cannot represent an impossible calendar date.
final_plan.limitations: This describes police-reported crashes present in the file, not all crashes. Full first-to-last date coverage in each year does not independently verify that every eligible record is present; records with missing or out-of-range crash_date are outside the selected population, and their number was not checked.
